title: Cross-Projection Index of Solved System-R Closures
description: Single authoritative source-of-truth for every headline System-R closure of the Relational Carrier Theory corpus. Each entry records the closure's owning (deriving) paper, its exact value, its claimed tier, and the papers that cross-reference it. The companion checker (verify_closure_index.py) validates this index for internal consistency and scans each owning paper's manuscript for the stated value, so that a value drifting in one paper but not another is caught at compendium-build time rather than by a reviewer. This index RECORDS what the corpus states; it does not impose tier judgements. Entries whose corpus-wide statements currently disagree are marked status=inconsistent and tracked, not silently reconciled.

tier_legend.OPEN: not yet closed at theorem level; may be empirically witnessed
tier_legend.CONSISTENCY_CHECK: numerical-reproduction or calibration-recovery residual; not a parameter-free closure
